subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `openclaw memory status` report builtin vector-store readiness from persisted `vectorDims` metadata, with `--deep` remaining the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and proven, but the user-visible status contract changes from live-probe-only unknownness to metadata-backed readiness, so maintainers should explicitly accept that semantics before merge.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if plain status should report prior successful vector indexing without loading sqlite-vec in that process.

options.title: Require Live-Probe Semantics
options.body: Ask for revised wording or a separate indexed-vector field if `Vector store: ready` must mean current-process sqlite-vec loadability.

options.title: Pause For A Different Contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redirect this PR if maintainers want a different status model.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if plain status should report prior successful vector indexing without loading sqlite-vec in that process.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is assigned to the PR and has recent memory-core migration/reindex history touching the same persisted metadata surface.
